case_name: Sri R Suresh Chandra vs Smt T Suma W/O Sri R Suresh Chandra

parties.respondent_defendant: Smt T Suma W/O Sri R Suresh Chandra (wife)

facts_of_case: Petitioner filed a petition under Sec.13(1)(ia) & (ib) of Hindu Marriage Act for dissolution of marriage. The trial court dismissed the petition.

legal_principles.principle: A petition for dissolution of marriage under Section 13(1)(ia) & (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act is not maintainable unless there are sufficient grounds.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that a petition for dissolution of marriage under Section 13(1)(ia) & (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act is not maintainable unless there are sufficient grounds.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is dismissed for non-prosecution.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for dissolution of marriage
appealing a judgment in a family court case
